steps._comment: E17: no ApplyStatus action. charm_pulse declared a UnityCc payload and NO vanilla method exists for it (no SetCharm* in Assembly-CSharp) — so the FA2 action this step used to expect reached the injector's status switch, matched no case, and did nothing. An inert plan item that read as a working effect. The status itself still applies, which is what the next step checks, and it still CC-locks in battle because that reads the cc CATEGORY.
